description: Data Protection Impact Assessment is not reviewed when there is a change to the risk represented by processing operations. Article 35.11 requires controllers to assess whether processing is performed in accordance with the DPIA.
applicability: Applicable when processing operations change materially, when risks evolve, or when new technologies are adopted that affect the original DPIA scope and conclusions.

metadata.detection_notes: Detected through comparison of processing operations with original DPIA and absence of review records when changes occur.
